cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-help-stays-in-player
cases.purpose: Both help entries open the shared searchable modal in the existing player, block playback keys and preserve playback through layered Escape.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-image-frames-publish-image-cells
cases.purpose: A graphical frame makes the native Component publish one scaled JPEG cropped into one display slice per canvas row, so the canvas occupies exactly its rows and the controls below it stay visible.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-retina-frames-scale-by-device-pixel-ratio
cases.purpose: The producer decodes at twice the canvas pixel size on a Retina display so the image is never upscaled by the window system.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-falls-back-to-ascii-on-terminal
cases.purpose: Without a graphical frame the requested image mode renders a density-ramp canvas while the state reports both modes.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-resolves-relative-file-names
cases.purpose: A source named relative to the caller's directory reaches the decoder as the absolute file name and plays.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-audio-sidecar-follows-playback
cases.purpose: An audio source starts one ffplay sidecar with the documented arguments while playing, releases it on pause, and stays silent while sound is off.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-volume-commands-restart-sidecar
cases.purpose: The volume keys change the level and restart the running sidecar with the documented volume.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-controls-pause-step-seek-speed
cases.purpose: Pause freezes the position, step presents one more frame, and seek and speed restart the producer with the documented arguments.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-finishes-and-restarts
cases.purpose: A producer that runs out of frames ends the player, keeps its last picture, and plays again from the start.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-streams-http-url
cases.purpose: An HTTP URL reaches ffmpeg with reconnect options while a non-HTTP scheme is rejected before any process starts.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-rejects-invalid-sources
cases.purpose: Unsupported sources and a missing ffmpeg signal user-error and leave no mounted buffer behind.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-documented-keys-reach-player
cases.purpose: The documented keys drive the player through the command loop instead of the renderer's own keymap, and closing leaves no buffer.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-open-interactively-shows-the-demo
cases.purpose: The generic open command reads nothing from the minibuffer and plays the built-in demo, while open-file remains the command that prompts for a name.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-plays-demo-with-real-ffmpeg
cases.purpose: The built-in demo plays through a real ffmpeg when one is installed, gated so other machines still run the fixture scenarios.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-playlist-navigates-and-edits
cases.purpose: A playlist opens by index and follows next, previous, enqueue and remove while keeping the running item addressable.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-playlist-auto-advances-with-loop
cases.purpose: An item that ends advances per loop policy: all wraps to the first item, none stops on the last one.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-playlist-shuffle-stays-in-range
cases.purpose: Shuffle reports its flag and next picks a different queue item within range.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-subtitles-parse-time-and-probe
cases.purpose: SubRip and WebVTT tracks parse into timed cues, the timeline answers lookups per second, unreadable files raise the documented error and the beside probe prefers the language suffix.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-subtitle-loads-beside-video-and-toggles
cases.purpose: A local video adopts the track beside it, the subtitle line reaches the buffer, and the c key hides and restores it.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-history-records-and-resumes
cases.purpose: Playback positions round-trip per file, a useful record resumes after open, and a record at the very end restarts from zero.

cases.name: etaf-video-player-tests-screenshot-writes-a-png
cases.purpose: The screenshot command decodes the current frame with a real ffmpeg into a readable PNG and returns the output path.
